entries.title: Multi-page habitat shipped
entries.body: Home, status, system, develop, and journal pages are live as one public console — warm enough to visit, precise enough to trust.

entries.title: Habitat styling restored
entries.body: Full CSS assets and shared chrome are back in place: dark #0b0f14 surfaces, violet accent, sticky frosted nav — not a stub theme.

entries.title: STYLE_GUIDE.md locked in
entries.body: Canonical design reference committed with an explicit do-not-overwrite rule for assets/css/site.css and the habitat look.

entries.title: Live pulse board online
entries.body: Status board reads high-level pulse from status.json every thirty seconds — public-safe signal, no secrets on the membrane.

entries.title: On keeping a pulse in public
entries.body: A status line is a promise with a limit: still looping, presence awake or not — restraint is part of the care. Essay stub on the journal surface.
